_doc: Factors and levels for run_testretest_processing_variance.py (comparison 2 of the plan).
Every level is one refit that differs from the session's base config in this factor only.
Level keys: 'name'; 'top' (top-level config keys, e.g. backend, aif_mode); 'set'
(a rater named by --rater-run: use that rater's AIF mask on this session's data);
'baseline' ('as_drawn' keeps the AIF file's own sidecar, 'auto' drops it so the baseline
end is auto-detected, {'from': RATER} uses that rater's sidecar).
steady_state_auto_method levels set baseline 'auto', since a sidecar baseline end would
outrank the detector. The rater factor crosses mask with baseline method, because rater
and baseline method are confounded in a plain AC-vs-WN comparison (plan, comparison 2).
